acceptance: scripts/site_inventory.py with unit tests (fixture site, deterministic output, diff classification)
Baseline inventory from current develop committed as text; path count and page count reported in the PR
Diff mode exits non-zero on any missing path or broken internal link
Make target added and registered in make/inventory.json
context: Sphinx uses the html builder (URLs end in .html). Blog posts live at /blog/YYYY-MM-DD-slug.html and the feed at /blog/atom.xml. Assemble copies _static and _images to the site root. The inventory must cover the routes captured by e2e/captures/public-site-pages.spec.ts.
description:
Add scripts/site_inventory.py. It reads an assembled site directory: the output of `assemble_public_site.py --site-dir site`, or the CI artifact public-site-assembled-*. It emits a deterministic, sorted JSON inventory with:
- every served path (html, xml, images, css/js referenced by pages)
- per HTML page: title, meta description, canonical, h1, ordered h2/h3 text, internal link targets, image srcs
- the atom.xml entry ids, titles and links
- the 404.html results SPA fallback (sessionStorage key benchbox.results.redirect)

Add a `diff` mode that compares two inventories and classifies each difference as missing path, changed heading, broken internal link, or missing image.

Commit the baseline inventory produced from current develop as a text file under _project/ (not a binary). This is the reference that astro-site-50 checks against.
